# Shilin Reproducibility Baseline 20260810

The immutable source bundle is stored locally in `bundle/` and excluded from Git because it is approximately 1.0 GB.

This snapshot was supplied by Shilin on 2026 08 10. Its internal relative layout is preserved so that the bundled `Web3AI4IO/Shilin/configs/pumpswap_case.json` continues to resolve the bundled upstream MVP project.

The snapshot must not be edited in place. New normalized data, coverage reports, and acquisition outputs belong outside `bundle/`.

Integrity was verified before relocation with the supplied `FILE_MANIFEST_SHA256.txt`. All 2,174 listed files passed SHA256 verification.

The bundle reports Shilin branch `agent/h4-agentic-release-update` at commit `e22ae233c097f3d05d2c850446dc60c4194942b1`.
